Title: Ishaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vimla - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
4. Kunal - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan walks across the courtyard.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Show me too!"

[Ishaan jumps with joy.]

Sunita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ishaan climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan hides behind the tree.]

Ishaan: "That's great!"

[Ishaan searches for his lost ball.]

Ishaan: "That's great!"

[Ishaan peeks out from behind the door.]

Ishaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Sunita, Vimla and Kunal stand near him.]

Kunal: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan catches the ball.]

Ishaan: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Sunita: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ishaan goes down the slide.]

Vimla: "Sunita, are you okay?"

[Ishaan plays with his dog.]

Vimla (surprised): "Careful!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Ishaan: "Kunal, look over here."

[Ishaan gets into the car.]

Sunita (gently): "That was fun!"

[Ishaan gets on the bus.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Ishaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
